issuer_rules: Referred client must be new to Schwab (has not been a Schwab client within the last 12 months)
Existing Schwab clients are not eligible; the referral must come from a current Schwab client

requirements: Become a Schwab client through a referral from an existing Schwab client
Make a qualifying net deposit of at least $25,000 into the new Schwab account within 45 days of becoming a client
Bonus tier is set by the qualifying net deposit: $25,000-$49,999.99 earns $100, $50,000-$99,999.99 earns $300, $100,000-$499,999.99 earns $500, $500,000 and over earns $1,000
The award is credited to the enrolled account approximately one week after the 45-day qualification period
The deposit must remain in the account for at least one year or the award may be forfeited
The bonus is taxable and may be reported on Form 1099-MISC
